notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
Will does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of all white and/or blue spells you cast this turn by at least {3}.
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {W} due to Will's ability, targeting any permanent.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Recruit the Worthy, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning it to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 2.
